science.title: Why resveratrol
science.text: Resveratrol is the polyphenol antioxidant that made red wine famous — but you'd need bottles of it to reach a meaningful dose. Found naturally in grapes, berries and Japanese knotweed, it's studied for the way it supports heart and vascular health and the body's antioxidant defences. Our capsules deliver a concentrated 600 mg, standardised to 50% trans-resveratrol — the most active form — so you get the benefit without the wine.

items.a: Resveratrol is a polyphenol antioxidant found naturally in grapes, berries and red wine — and, in concentrated form, in Japanese knotweed (Polygonum cuspidatum). It's studied for supporting heart health and the body's antioxidant defences.

Trans-resveratrol is the most bioactive form of the molecule. Our 600 mg complex is standardised to 50% trans-resveratrol, so you get a meaningful, consistent dose of the active form in every capsule.
One capsule daily, ideally 20–30 minutes before a meal with water. Because it's fat-soluble, taking it with food that contains a little fat can help absorption.
Yes — the resveratrol is plant-sourced (Japanese knotweed root) in a vegetable (hypromellose) capsule, with no animal ingredients.
If you're pregnant or nursing, under 18, or have a medical condition or take medication (especially blood thinners), consult a physician before use.
